Special Meeting of Electors

Tuesday, August 1, 2023 - 06:00 PM

Location: Denmark Recreation Centre, McLean Park, Brazier Street, Denmark

The Shire President has accepted a request from 373 Electors to hold a Special Electors Meeting to discuss the following:

The decision of the Shire of Denmark Council on item 9.3.1 at the 18 April 2023 Ordinary Council Meeting which endorsed (among other things) the termination of the Lions Club lease of Pt Crown Reserve 30277 and the granting of an expanded lease over this reserve to the Kwoorabup Nature School.

An Elector is a person who is eligible to be enrolled to vote in Shire of Denmark Local Government Elections, and Ratepayers.

All Electors are welcome to attend.

For further information please contact the Governance Coordinator on telephone 9848 0324 or email claire.thompson@denmark.wa.gov.au.

23 October 2023 - Special Council Meeting

Monday, October 23, 2023 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 953 South Coast Highway, Denmark, WA

A Special Meeting of Council will be held on Monday, 23 October 2023, in the Council Chambers,

953 South Coast Highway, Denmark, commencing at 5.00pm.

The purpose of the meeting is to:

  1. Elect the Shire President and Deputy Shire President; and
  2. Conduct the table seating draw.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Public question time will be limited to items on the Agenda.

For further information please contact the Governance Coordinator on telephone 9848 0324 or email claire.thompson@denmark.wa.gov.au.

Annual Electors Meeting

Tuesday, March 1, 2022 - 06:00 PM

In accordance with the Provisions of the Local Government Act 1995, Electors of the Shire of Denmark are hereby notified that Council has resolved to hold its Annual General Meeting of Electors on Tuesday, 1 March 2022 at 6.00 pm in the Shire of Denmark Council Chambers, 953 South Coast Highway, Denmark.

 The business to be conducted at the meeting will include:

  • Shire President's Report;
  • Chief Executive Officer’s Report;
  • 2019/20 Auditors Report;
  • 2019/20 Annual Report incorporating Annual Financial Statements; and
  • General Business.

Copies of the Annual Report are now available for viewing at:

  • Shire of Denmark Administration Office: 953 South Coast Highway, Denmark, 6333;
  • Denmark Public Library: 1 Strickland Street, Denmark, 6333; and
  • Shire of Denmark Website: https://www.denmark.wa.gov.au/annual-reports.aspx

For further information please contact the Shire on telephone 9848 0300 or email enquiries@denmark.wa.gov.au

David Schober
ACTING CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Annual Electors Meeting

Tuesday, April 27, 2021 - 04:20 PM

In accordance with the Provisions of the Local Government Act 1995, Electors of the Shire of Denmark are hereby notified that Council has resolved to hold its Annual General Meeting of Electors on Tuesday, 27 April 2021 at 6.00 pm in the Shire of Denmark Council Chambers, 953 South Coast Highway, Denmark.

 The business to be conducted at the meeting will include:

  • Shire President's Report;
  • Chief Executive Officer’s Report;
  • 2019/20 Auditors Report;
  • 2019/20 Annual Report incorporating Annual Financial Statements; and
  • General Business.

Copies of the Annual Report are now available for viewing at:

  • Shire of Denmark Administration Office: 953 South Coast Highway, Denmark, 6333;
  • Denmark Public Library: 1 Strickland Street, Denmark, 6333; and
  • Shire of Denmark Website: denmark.wa.gov.au/annual-reports.aspx

For further information please contact the Shire on telephone 9848 0300 or email enquiries@denmark.wa.gov.au

David Schober
ACTING CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Annual Electors Meeting

Tuesday, February 4, 2020 - 06:00 PM

In accordance with the Provisions of the Local Government Act 1995, Electors of the Shire of Denmark are hereby notified that Council has resolved to hold its Annual General Meeting of Electors on Tuesday, 4 February 2020 at 6.00 pm in the Shire of Denmark Council Chambers, 953 South Coast Highway, Denmark.

 The business to be conducted at the meeting will include:

  • Shire President's Report;
  • Chief Executive Officer’s Report;
  • 2018/19 Auditors Report;
  • 2018/19 Annual Report incorporating Annual Financial Statements; and
  • General Business.

Copies of the Annual Report are now available for viewing at:

  • Shire of Denmark Administration Office: 953 South Coast Highway, Denmark, 6333;
  • Denmark Public Library: 1 Strickland Street, Denmark, 6333; and
  • Shire of Denmark Website: denmark.wa.gov.au/annual-reports.aspx

For further information please contact the Shire on telephone 9848 0300 or email enquiries@denmark.wa.gov.au

David Schober
ACTING CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Special Meeting of Council

Tuesday, December 1, 2020 - 04:00 PM

A Special Meeting of Council will be held on Tuesday, 1 December 2020, in the Council Chambers, 953 South Coast Highway, Denmark, commencing at 4.00pm for the purpose of considering a short-term proposal from the Denmark Chamber of Commerce to address visitor servicing for the Summer and Autumn seasons.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Enquiries to Governance Coordinator on email claire.thompson@denmark.wa.gov.au.

Council Meetings

Council holds decision making meetings on the last Tuesday of every month commencing at 4pm. All Ordinary Council Meetings are held at Council Chambers at 953 South Coast Highway, Denmark. Details about previous meetings, including minutes and summaries of reports and resolutions can be accessed on our Past Council Meetings page.

Enquiries related to Council Meetings can be directed to our  Governance Coordinator on (08) 9848 0300 or info@denmark.wa.gov.au. Contact details for Elected Members are available on our Councillors page. 

Public Question Time, Deputations, Presentations & Petitions

The procedure for the Presiding Officer of a Council or Committee Meeting dealing with Public Questions or Presentations, Deputations and Petitions is detailed in the relevant Council Policy. The procedures in the policy may be amended in a declared public health emergency.
